name: Arc Totem Hierophant
summary: Arc on Spell Totem, with the Hierophant mana and totem package behind it. The totems cast while you move, so the build is easier on the hands than a self-cast Arc and still scales with the same spell gear. No required unique.

pros.text: Totems cast while you move, so positioning is less punishing.
No required unique; spell damage and gem levels carry the build.
Hierophant mana recovery makes the totem cost sustainable.
Arc clears packs without precise aiming.
A comfortable first mapping build for a new league.
The same spell sceptre and shield serve self-cast and totem versions.

cons.text: Totem placement and uptime are a second thing to manage.
Single-target needs both totems alive through the whole fight.
Clear speed is slower than a bow or a well-geared melee build.
Mana is tight before the Hierophant package is online.
Totems can be killed by area damage.
The build wants a six-link for its best damage.

pantheon.note: Gruthkul reduces the physical hits that catch a stationary caster.

summary.text: Arc Totem Hierophant is a spell-totem build that measures 39.0k at red maps and 70.8k at pinnacle. The totems cast while you position, and no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Rolling Magma, then switch to Arc and Spell Totem when both are available. The first checkpoint measures 377 life and 49 damage; the second measures 77.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 39.0k damage, 19545 effective life and 8204 physical max hit. Keep both totems down, cap the elemental resistances, and let the filter hide the rest.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 70.8k damage with 25246 effective life and 9050 physical max hit. Place the totems before the burst and be ready to replace them after every phase.
